buyer.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and would like to reach an agreement that works for both sides.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01); our agreement provides for 90 days (ctr:4600070110).
Electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

On this basis we propose: EUR 125.83 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.

We confirm a binding volume of 8150 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01); our agreement provides for 90 days (ctr:4600070110).

On this basis we propose: EUR 125.83 per unit, valid from 2026-11-01, payment 14 days net, for our full demand of 8150 units a year over 12 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

buyer.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We have read your letter and we understand the surcharge question. Our demand for the peeled 1.4404 bar is growing: our current forecast puts next year above this year's volume, and the whole requirement, this year's and the growth, is placed with you for the full term. What we need in return is a base price that reflects that commitment and the fact that your material is covered at fixed prices until next spring.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.
Our forecast for the coming year is 96600 units, and that growth is placed with you as well.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.

On this basis we propose: EUR 5.19 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

buyer.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost background. You asked what volume we would commit to; the binding volume is set out below. It is our full demand for this part, all placed with you. Our forecast is rising, and a long contract term would give you planning security.

We note your letter of 2026-07-06 says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not yet reach your costs. The data that follows also shows the recent direction of the alloy surcharge and producer prices. Given your forward buying, would you be willing to walk us through your calculation, as your owner once offered?

In return for the price, we offer the full volume and a 36-month term. We can structure the deal either at a fixed price or with the material index applying to its share of the price and a deadband, so that both sides share that risk. Please consider which structure suits you best; our proposal and the supporting data follow.

We confirm a binding volume of 94800 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.

Our proposal in detail, one of these packages:
- Option A: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months
- Option B: EUR 4.71 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reviewing our offer and moving your proposal. We appreciate the revised terms and your explanation that AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so recent index declines do not affect your current material costs. We also understand your position on keeping your internal calculation models confidential. The index changes you cite, and the basis for your calculation, are addressed in the data that follow.

Our full demand for this part is fixed with you over the term, and our forecast is rising. The 36-month commitment gives you planning security; we are prepared to offer that alongside our full volume. We also note your alternative at 30 days net and €5.58 per unit, and your revised offer at €5.64 with 90 days net. Our last 3 orders were at €5.45, so our proposal moves toward you again while linking only the specified share of the price to AS-14404.

The data below set out the basis for our position, followed by our proposed terms for the full demand.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.02 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for reviewing our offer and moving your price again. We appreciate the adjustment and understand that your calculation reflects AS-14404, PPI-C2431 and LCI-C. We also recognize that you bought material forward at fixed prices, which shapes your cost position.

Our proposal moves toward you again while reflecting the value we can offer in return: our full demand for this part is fixed with you for the term, and our forecast is rising. The long contract term also provides planning security. In balancing that commitment against the price, we propose linking only part of the price to AS-14404, rather than making the whole price subject to that movement.

You previously offered to walk us through your calculation, and we would welcome that discussion. The data supporting our position follows, then our complete proposal.

In our call of 2026-04-21 (doc:20260421-70710-M2) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

Our proposal in detail: EUR 5.17 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.

We confirm a binding volume of 15900 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 42.30 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Seidl,

I understand that alloy and producer costs have been important parts of your calculation, and appreciate your owner’s offer to walk us through it. You asked what volume we can commit to. Our full demand for this part is fixed and will be placed with you; our forecast is rising, and a long contract gives you planning security. We have set out two ways to share the commercial risk: a fixed price, or a price linked to the material index with a deadband. Could you let us know which structure suits you better? - Option B: EUR 4.72 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 5%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months

Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and your kind words. We value our long cooperation with your family foundry and the care your team puts into every PH-100 housing.

We understand that labour costs have risen. We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

We would like to give you more security with a longer partnership, and propose three packages:
- Option A: EUR 50.60 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.27 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01
- Option C: EUR 50.20 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the care you took in checking our figures. We appreciate that you moved on the price and agreed to our payment terms. After our long partnership, that means a lot to us. We understand that your quality investments and wage increases matter, and we want your foundry to stay strong.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342).

We would like to take a step toward you and keep the package you answered. We see two options:

- Option A: EUR 50.72 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 50.37 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Der verbindliche Abnahmeumfang steht direkt nach diesem Absatz; unsere Bestellung ist fix und umfasst unsere komplette Abnahme über die Vertragslaufzeit ausschließlich bei Ihnen. Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for your kind words. We truly value our long cooperation with your family foundry and the care your team puts into every PH-100 housing. We also take your point on metal-industry wages seriously.

We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard (sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2, sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3). We have a bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part (cost:part:PH-100).

To give you more planning security, we propose a longer 24-month term, valid from 1 December 2026, in one of two forms:
- Option A: EUR 48.60 per unit, payment 60 days net.
- Option B: EUR 47.04 per unit, payment 30 days net.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

We look forward to hearing from you and to continuing our good work together.

Warm regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your reply and for moving on the price. We appreciate it, and we value our 12 years of working together just as highly as you do.

We have compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part (po:4500001201, po:4500001288, po:4500001342). With that in mind, we would like to take a step toward you and keep the 24-month package you welcomed. We can offer three options:

- Option A: EUR 48.99 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027
- Option B: EUR 48.93 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026
- Option C: EUR 48.60 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027

Is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us?

We look forward to hearing from you and to continuing our cooperation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you, and your team, for the careful reply. We appreciate that you moved on the price and answered our question on payment days, and that you checked the price history and past order prices so thoroughly. Thank you also for confirming that the PH-100 is cast strictly to our drawing.

We noticed that your message contained two versions, with different prices, payment terms and start dates. To keep things simple, we have moved most of the way towards you and set out two options, one for each start date:

- Option A: EUR 49.59 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-04-01
- Option B: EUR 49.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months, valid from 2026-12-01

After twelve years together, we value this partnership greatly and are confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Your e-mail contains two sets of terms: €49.70 per unit from 1 December 2026, and €49.90 per unit from 1 April 2027. We have built on the first. Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you very much for your offer for the stainless pump shaft SH-220, and for your kind words about building a long-term partnership. We appreciate the care you put into your proposal.

We would like to suggest two packages for your consideration:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.83 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Both options include delivery to our site in Hollerau, so each side knows exactly what is expected. Option B gives you faster payment in return for the slightly lower price.

To help us understand your offer better, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quotation for the stainless pump shaft SH-220.

We have reviewed your terms and would like to propose two packages:

- Option A: EUR 15.90 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 15.74 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Both packages have the same lead time and delivery terms. Option A gives you a slightly higher price with longer payment terms. Option B offers a slightly lower price in exchange for faster payment. We would welcome your view on either package.

To help us understand your pricing, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

Thank you in advance for your reply.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your thoughtful reply, and for taking up the 14-day payment term so readily. We appreciate the care you have put into working with us on the SH-220 shaft, and we understand that including freight and logistics changes your cost picture.

We would like to keep our price where it is and offer you a choice of two packages:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.53 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW

Option B leaves the freight with us, so you can stay with your original EXW basis.

We would also value your view on one point: is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us? We would be glad to look at any idea together.

Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you very much for your offer for the stainless pump shaft SH-220, and for your kind words about building a long-term partnership. We appreciate the care you put into your proposal.

We would like to suggest two packages for your consideration:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.83 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Both options include delivery to our site in Hollerau, so each side knows exactly what is expected. Option B gives you faster payment in return for the slightly lower price.

To help us understand your offer better, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quotation for the stainless pump shaft SH-220.

We have reviewed your terms and would like to propose two packages:

- Option A: EUR 15.90 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 15.74 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Both packages have the same lead time and delivery terms. Option A gives you a slightly higher price with longer payment terms. Option B offers a slightly lower price in exchange for faster payment. We would welcome your view on either package.

To help us understand your pricing, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

Thank you in advance for your reply.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your thoughtful reply, and for taking up the 14-day payment term so readily. We appreciate the care you have put into working with us on the SH-220 shaft, and we understand that including freight and logistics changes your cost picture.

We would like to keep our price where it is and offer you a choice of two packages:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.53 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW

Option B leaves the freight with us, so you can stay with your original EXW basis.

We would also value your view on one point: is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us? We would be glad to look at any idea together.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and the cost breakdown. We note that you have moved on price and accepted payment at 14 days net, which supports your raw material purchasing.

Another bidder quotes EUR 15.90 per unit for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-2).

We have moved a step toward you. Option A keeps the package you answered, and Option B is a lower price if you deliver ex works instead of to our site:
